title: Velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v = E/B = 1000 m/s from force balance in region I.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes that straight-line motion in region I requires qE = qvB, giving v = E/B.

title: Circular motion radius
description: Important: Applies qvB = mv²/r to find r = mv/(qB) = 0.1 m for region II.

title: D coordinate calculation
description: Essential: Correctly determines D coordinates as (0.50 m, 0) using geometry of circular arc and exit trajectory.

title: Total time O to D
description: Essential: Correctly sums t₁ (region I), t₂ (arc in region II), and t₃ (post-region II) to get ≈6.57×10⁻⁴ s.

title: Geometry of exit
description: Important: Uses angles (53°, 37°) and radius to find exit point from region II and subsequent straight-line path to x-axis.

title: Time breakdown
description: Optional: Shows separate calculations for t₁ = OA/(v cos53°), t₂ = (πr)/(2v), t₃ = y/(v cos53°).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign of charge in Lorentz force or electric force, leading to incorrect force balance or circular motion direction.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Fails to convert cm to m consistently, resulting in wrong numerical values for coordinates or times.
